verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is that users can "import or sync your contacts and activity data". This implies bulk ingestion of profiles, but nothing documents bulk API endpoints, batch jobs, or bulk updates and deletes. Cursor pagination of up to 200 events per page is a bulk read, not a bulk operation, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints (e.g., bulk profile import or subscribe jobs), bulk update/delete operations, MCP or agent-driven bulk actions, limits and status tracking for bulk jobs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
